title: OUT FIRST WATCHES AND PINGS
why: His 2.25 b and g-54: the player out first watches their partner live and can still ping. Watch: the watching window must keep its frame rate while it runs the simulation; a watcher ping must name its sender; waiting must never look like the run ended.
now: Extracted demo players follow the partner with a small waiting line. N, middle mouse and the pad ping still mark targets, including double-tap danger, without rejoining or using the map. The retained career host can also watch and ping until the party finishes.
